skills.name: Light of Retribution
skills.description: Rafaela strikes the three nearest enemies with <font color='#404495'>(Light of Retribution)</font>, dealing them 225<font color='#27C0C7'>( +120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font>, briefly revealing their positions, and slowing them by 40% for 1.5s. Enemies hit by <font color='#404495'>(Light of Retribution)</font> again within 5s will take 20% extra damage (this effect stacks up to 3 times).
skills.tips: This is the main damage skill of Rafaela, and at the same time, is the biggest debuffs skill from her too. With the correct equipments, this skill is not only about revealing enemy's stealth and slow them down, it can also burn, reduce enemy's regen effects and even reduce enemy's defense too!

skills.name: Holy Healing
skills.description:
Rafaela calls upon <font color='#404495'>(Holy Light)</font>, restoring 100<font color='#27C0C7'>( +35% Total Magic Power)</font> HP to nearby allied heroes, plus an additional 150<font color='#27C0C7'>( +45% Total Magic Power)</font> HP to herself and the most injured allied hero in range. Also increases the Movement Speed of nearby allied heroes by 30% and grants Slow Immunity for 1s.
Every 20 point(s) of Magic Power will add 1% to the Movement Speed bonus.
skills.tips: This the healing skill, in contrast of her damage-skill, there no equipment to give her better buffs, and yet, this is the skill what most people expect from her.

skills.name: Holy Baptism
skills.description: Rafaela unleashes the true power of <font color='#404495'>(Holy Light)</font> in the target direction, dealing 460<font color='#27C0C7'>( +120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies in a line and stunning them for 1.2s.
skills.tips: In early game, you can trick you enemy to dive into your turret and stun him, then let the turret do its job, be aware of the enemy's minion, if there is any, wait for them to hit you once first.

skills.name: Deity Penalization
skills.description: When Rafaela is killed, she turns into a beam of <font color='#404495'>(Holy Light)</font> and launches herself at her killer after a 2s delay. This attack deals <font color='#E5CB19'>(True Damage)</font> equal to 20% of the target's Max HP upon hit and can be blocked by other enemy heroes, dealing damage to them instead. This effect won't be triggered if the killer is a non-hero enemy or if they're too far away.
skills.tips: This passive may be seems like a joke, but if you know how to take advantage of this, be sure that no enemy can run away from you, same as be sure that you can save your low-hp teammates!

items.name: Enchanted Talisman
items.des: Unique Passive - Mana Spring: Regenerates 15% Max Mana every 10s.

items.name: Necklace of Durance
items.des: Unique Passive - Gift: Regenerates 20% Max HP and Mana over 2s after leveling up.

items.name: Oracle
items.des: Unique Passive - Bless: Received Shield and HP Regen effects are increased by 30%.

items.name: Immortality
items.des: Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).

items.name: Guardian Helmet
items.des: Unique Passive - Recovery: Regenerates 2.5% Max HP per second (reduced to 0.5% Max HP per second over 5s after taking damage).

builds.tips: There are 3 gears that is a must for a support-type Rafaela. After getting those 3 gears, you are already in middle game and its time to check your team and enemy's team build for your next 3 gears.
